title: Sarcopenia and Frailty — Strength Training Keeps Older Adults Independent

hook.en: Losing muscle with age is not just "getting old": it is a treatable condition called sarcopenia, and it leads to falls, hospital stays and loss of independence. Strength training is the most effective treatment, even in people in their eighties and nineties. Learn to screen, measure and prescribe it safely.
hook.ur: Umar ke saath muscle kam hona sirf "budhapa" nahi: yeh qabil-e-ilaj halat hai jise sarcopenia kehte hain, aur yeh girne, hospital mein rehne aur khud-mukhtari khone ki taraf le jati hai. Strength training is ka sab se mo'assir ilaj hai, assi aur nabbe saal ke logon mein bhi. Screening, naap aur mehfooz nuskha likhna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll define sarcopenia and frailty, screen with grip strength, chair stands and gait speed, prescribe progressive resistance training at an effective dose, and add protein and balance advice.
goal.ur: End tak aap sarcopenia aur frailty ki tareef karenge, grip strength, chair stands aur gait speed se screening karenge, mo'assir dosage par progressive resistance training likhenge, aur protein aur balance ka mashwara shamil karenge.

text.en: **Sarcopenia** is the loss of **muscle strength** (first) and **muscle mass** with age, leading to poor physical performance. **Frailty** is a wider state of reduced reserve across many body systems, so that a small stress (a chest infection, a fall) causes a big decline. Low strength is measured simply: **grip strength below 27 kg in men or 16 kg in women**, or **taking more than 15 seconds for 5 chair stands**, and **gait speed of 0.8 m/s or less** shows severe sarcopenia. The good news is that **progressive resistance training** builds strength at any age.
text.ur: **Sarcopenia** umar ke saath **muscle ki taqat** (pehle) aur **muscle ki miqdar** ka kam hona hai, jis se jismani karkardagi kamzor hoti hai. **Frailty** ek wasee halat hai jis mein jism ke kai nizaam ka reserve kam ho jata hai, is liye chhota sa dabao (seene ka infection, girna) bari girawat laata hai. Kam taqat aasani se naapi jati hai: **mardon mein grip strength 27 kg se kam ya khawateen mein 16 kg se kam**, ya **5 chair stands mein 15 second se zyada lagna**, aur **0.8 m/s ya kam gait speed** shadeed sarcopenia dikhati hai. Achhi khabar yeh hai ke **progressive resistance training** har umar mein taqat banati hai.

text.en: Muscle in older age is like a **savings account for independence**. Every illness or bed rest is a large withdrawal. Strength training is the **regular deposit**: the bigger the balance, the more a person can lose during an illness and still walk, climb stairs and use the toilet alone.
text.ur: Budhape mein muscle **khud-mukhtari ka bachat khata** hai. Har bimari ya bistar par aaram ek bari nikasi hai. Strength training **baqaida jama** hai: jitna zyada balance, utna hi shakhs bimari mein kho kar bhi chal sakta hai, seedhiyan chadh sakta hai aur akele toilet istemal kar sakta hai.

steps.title: Screen and measure
steps.detail: Ask about falls, slow walking and difficulty rising from a chair (the SARC-F questionnaire). Measure grip strength with a dynamometer, time 5 chair stands, and measure gait speed over 4 metres. || Screening aur naap

steps.title: Prescribe progressive resistance training
steps.detail: Train the major muscles (legs especially) 2 to 3 times a week: 2 to 3 sets of 8 to 12 repetitions at a load that feels hard (about 7 to 8 out of 10 effort), progressing the load when 12 repetitions become easy. || Progressive resistance training likhein

steps.title: Add balance and function
steps.detail: Combine strength with balance work (standing on one leg with support, heel-to-toe walking) and real tasks: sit-to-stand, stairs, carrying shopping. || Balance aur function shamil karein

steps.title: Support with protein and review
steps.detail: Encourage enough protein spread across meals (often about 1.0 to 1.2 g per kg per day for older adults, unless the doctor advises otherwise, for example in kidney disease). Re-measure grip, chair stands and gait speed every 8 to 12 weeks. || Protein se sahara aur dobara jaanch

question.en: Which finding suggests low muscle strength (probable sarcopenia) in an older woman?
question.ur: Buzurg khatoon mein kaun si cheez kam muscle taqat (mumkina sarcopenia) dikhati hai?

feedback.en: Yes — below 16 kg in women suggests low strength.
feedback.ur: Haan — khawateen mein 16 kg se kam kam taqat dikhata hai.
Yeh 15 second ki hadd se kam hai.

feedback.en: That is a normal, healthy speed.

text.en: **Heavy enough to be hard.** Older muscles grow when the load feels hard by the last repetitions; very light "keep moving" exercise alone does not build strength.
text.ur: **Itna bhaari ke mushkil ho.** Buzurg muscles tab barhte hain jab aakhri repetitions tak load mushkil lage; sirf bohat halki "harkat karte raho" exercise taqat nahi banati.

text.en: **Giving only very light exercises because the patient is old.** Gentle range-of-movement exercise keeps joints moving but does not reverse sarcopenia. With good screening and supervision, older adults tolerate and benefit from moderate to high loads.
text.ur: **Mareez buzurg hai is liye sirf bohat halki exercises dena.** Narm range-of-movement exercise joints ko harkat mein rakhti hai magar sarcopenia ko ulta nahi karti. Achhi screening aur nigrani ke saath buzurg darmiyani se zyada load bardasht karte hain aur faida uthate hain.

question.en: An 80-year-old easily does 12 sit-to-stands from a chair. How should you progress?
question.ur: 80 saal ka shakhs kursi se aasani se 12 sit-to-stands kar leta hai. Kaise aage barhayein?

feedback.en: That trains endurance more than strength.
feedback.ur: Yeh taqat se zyada endurance ki training hai.

text.en: Keep the same exercise for months

feedback.ur: Barhaye baghair faida ruk jata hai.

text.en: Add load (hold a weight or use a lower chair) so 8 to 12 repetitions feel hard again
text.ur: Load barhayein (wazan pakrein ya neechi kursi istemal karein) taake 8 se 12 repetitions phir se mushkil lagen

feedback.en: Yes — progression keeps the stimulus strong enough.
feedback.ur: Haan — barhana stimulus ko kaafi mazboot rakhta hai.

question.en: Why does a short hospital stay hit older adults so hard?
question.ur: Chhota sa hospital stay buzurgon ko itni sakhti se kyun nuqsan deta hai?

text.en: Bed rest causes rapid muscle loss, and they start with little reserve
text.ur: Bistar par aaram tezi se muscle kam karta hai, aur un ka reserve pehle hi kam hota hai

feedback.en: Yes — a few days in bed can cost a large share of leg strength.
feedback.ur: Haan — bistar mein chand din taangon ki taqat ka bara hissa kha sakte hain.

text.en: Hospital food has too much protein
text.ur: Hospital ke khane mein bohat protein hota hai

text.en: Older muscles cannot change at all
text.ur: Buzurg muscles bilkul badal nahi sakte

feedback.ur: Woh training ka achha jawab dete hain.

text.en: **Use the home as the gym.** A sturdy chair, stairs with a rail, water bottles or bags of rice as weights, and a timetable on the fridge are enough to start. Teach a family member to supervise. Short, regular sessions after a meal or prayer fit daily life well.
text.ur: **Ghar ko gym banayein.** Mazboot kursi, railing wali seedhiyan, pani ki botalen ya chawal ke thele wazan ke taur par, aur fridge par timetable shuru karne ke liye kaafi hain. Ghar ke ek fard ko nigrani sikhayein. Khane ya namaz ke baad chhote, baqaida sessions rozmarra zindagi mein achhi tarah fit hote hain.

question.en: Why is strength measured before muscle mass in modern definitions?
question.ur: Jadeed tareefon mein muscle mass se pehle strength kyun naapi jati hai?

answer.en: Low strength predicts falls, disability and death better than low muscle size, and it is quick and cheap to measure with a grip dynamometer or a chair. Mass needs scanning equipment (DEXA, bioimpedance), so it is used to confirm the diagnosis rather than to find it.
answer.ur: Kam taqat girne, ma'zoori aur maut ki behtar paishgoi karti hai bajaye kam muscle size ke, aur grip dynamometer ya kursi se jaldi aur sasti naapi jati hai. Mass ke liye scanning ka saman chahiye (DEXA, bioimpedance), is liye isay tashkhees dhoondne ke bajaye pakki karne ke liye istemal kiya jata hai.

beats.patient: A 78-year-old widow lives alone. She has fallen once this year, walks slowly to the shop and uses her arms to rise from a chair. Her grip strength is 13 kg, 5 chair stands take 19 seconds and gait speed is 0.7 m/s. There are no red flags and her doctor has reviewed her medicines.
beats.assessment: She has severe sarcopenia and a high falls risk, but nothing that stops exercise.
beats.treatment: Progressive resistance training 3 times a week (chair stands, step-ups, heel raises, wall push-ups) with balance practice, at a hard effort; a protein-rich meal plan; a family member to supervise; and review every 8 to 12 weeks.
beats.reassess: After 12 weeks her grip is 16 kg, chair stands take 13 seconds, gait speed is 0.9 m/s and she walks to the shop without stopping.

text.en: **Check before loading:** recent fractures, chest pain or breathlessness on effort, uncontrolled blood pressure, dizziness on standing, or unexplained weight loss need medical review first. **Supervise balance work** with a support within reach. Breathe out during the effort (no breath-holding), and stop for chest pain, palpitations, dizziness or new joint swelling.
text.ur: **Load se pehle check karein:** haal ki fracture, mehnat par seene mein dard ya saans phoolna, be-qaboo blood pressure, khare hone par chakkar, ya bewajah wazan girna ke liye pehle medical jaanch chahiye. **Balance ke kaam ki nigrani karein** haath ki pohanch mein sahare ke saath. Mehnat ke dauran saans bahar nikalein (saans na rokein), aur seene ke dard, dil ki tez dharkan, chakkar ya joint ki nayi sujan par rok dein.

summary.en: Sarcopenia is low muscle strength and mass with age; frailty is low reserve across many systems, and sarcopenia is a major cause of it.
summary.ur: Sarcopenia umar ke saath kam muscle taqat aur miqdar hai; frailty kai nizaamon mein kam reserve hai, aur sarcopenia is ki bari wajah hai.

summary.en: Screen with grip (below 27 kg men, 16 kg women), 5 chair stands (over 15 seconds) and gait speed (0.8 m/s or less means severe).
summary.ur: Grip (mard 27 kg se kam, khawateen 16 kg se kam), 5 chair stands (15 second se zyada) aur gait speed (0.8 m/s ya kam yani shadeed) se screening karein.

summary.en: Progressive resistance training 2 to 3 times a week at a hard effort, with balance work and enough protein, rebuilds strength at any age.
summary.ur: Hafte mein 2 se 3 baar mushkil mehnat par progressive resistance training, balance ke kaam aur kaafi protein ke saath, har umar mein taqat dobara banati hai.

front.ur: Kam taqat ke liye grip strength ki hadd?

back.en: Below 27 kg in men and below 16 kg in women (EWGSOP2).
back.ur: Mardon mein 27 kg se kam aur khawateen mein 16 kg se kam (EWGSOP2).

front.ur: Kam taqat ke liye chair stand ki hadd?

back.en: More than 15 seconds for 5 chair stands.
back.ur: 5 chair stands mein 15 second se zyada.

front.en: Gait speed that indicates severe sarcopenia?
front.ur: Shadeed sarcopenia dikhane wali gait speed?

front.en: Effective resistance dose for older adults?
front.ur: Buzurgon ke liye mo'assir resistance dosage?

back.en: 2 to 3 times a week, 2 to 3 sets of 8 to 12 at a hard effort, progressed over time.
back.ur: Hafte mein 2 se 3 baar, mushkil mehnat par 8 se 12 ke 2 se 3 sets, waqt ke saath barhate hue.
